rules.statement: A sale of land by a minor without the sanction of court is voidable, and the minor's remedy is by way of restitutio in integrum unless she has derived substantial benefit. In such cases, the minor must indemnify the other party and put them back to their original position.
rules.supporting_quote: "In our Courts, as far as I have been able to discover, applications for restitutio in integrum have always been made to the Supreme Court by minors as well as by persons of full capacity and have been confined to cases in which the application is based on the discovery of fresh evidence or on allegation that the applicant has been surprised into a position of prejudice and disadvantage in the course of a judicial proceeding."
